apiDescriptions./inventory: A fictional inventory API for Trailhead Supply. Browse two products, inspect in-stock and out-of-stock snapshots, and try reservation success, cancellation, and failure scenarios. These static examples do not change stock or store reservations. POST bodies are optional; supplied non-empty JSON is syntax-checked, but field values and query strings never select responses. Use the explicit demo-faults routes to exercise business errors and warehouse outages.

endpoints.name: Inventory API health
endpoints.description:
Description:
Let a storefront or fulfillment agent check that the Trailhead Supply inventory mock is reachable without inspecting stock or reserving products.

Technical implementation:
HEAD returns a fixed 200 OK with sample headers and no response body. This is a mock endpoint subject to instance API-key protection, not a live warehouse or dependency check. GET is not configured.

endpoints.name: Browse inventory
endpoints.description:
Description:
Help a Trailhead Supply shopper browse the catalog and see which products are available before choosing an item.

Technical implementation:
Returns two fictional products with fixed available quantities and links to their detail endpoints. Query strings do not filter or paginate this static list.

endpoints.name: Inspect an in-stock product
endpoints.description:
Description:
Let a shopper or fulfillment agent check how many Trail flasks can be ordered, including the quantities already reserved at the warehouse.

Technical implementation:
GET returns a fixed JSON stock snapshot for SKU-1001 in warehouse WH-DEMO-01. Reservation and cancellation calls never change these quantities.

endpoints.name: Inspect an out-of-stock product
endpoints.description:
Description:
Show a shopper that the Day pack is a recognized product but currently unavailable, so the storefront can display an out-of-stock message rather than a missing-product page.

Technical implementation:
Returns 200 OK for an existing product with zero available stock. Distinguish an unavailable product from a missing SKU; no live warehouse is queried.

endpoints.name: Look up a missing product
endpoints.description:
Description:
Help a storefront or support agent handle a product code that Trailhead Supply does not recognize and guide the shopper back to the catalog.

Technical implementation:
The literal unknown SKU route always returns a configured 404 problem response. This is not a route template; other unconfigured SKU paths receive MockAPI's ordinary unmatched response.

response.body: {"type":"about:blank","title":"Not Found","status":404,"detail":"The sample SKU does not exist.","sku":"unknown"}

endpoints.name: Reserve inventory
endpoints.description:
Description:
Demonstrate holding two Trail flasks for a shopper during checkout so the order journey can show an inventory reservation confirmation.

Technical implementation:
Simulates a reservation of two trail flasks with 201 Created and a resolvable Location header. Body fields are ignored; no stock is reduced and the lookup exists before this call.

endpoints.name: Inspect the sample reservation
endpoints.description:
Description:
Let a checkout application or support agent review the products and quantities held for a sample order before fulfillment.

Technical implementation:
Always returns the same sample reservation, including before creation and after cancellation. It is a static lookup, not persisted reservation state.

endpoints.name: Cancel the sample reservation
endpoints.description:
Description:
Demonstrate releasing a shopper's inventory hold when checkout is abandoned or an order is canceled.

Technical implementation:
Simulates cancellation with 204 No Content. Nothing is deleted or released; repeated calls succeed and the reservation lookup and stock snapshots remain unchanged.

endpoints.name: Insufficient stock fault demo
endpoints.description:
Description:
Exercise the checkout message shown when a shopper requests more Day packs than are available, allowing the shopper to reduce the quantity or choose another product.

Technical implementation:
Always returns 409 Conflict for a fictional request for three day packs when none are available. Request field values do not select this outcome and no stock check is performed.

response.body: {"type":"about:blank","title":"Conflict","status":409,"detail":"There is not enough sample stock to reserve this item.","sku":"SKU-1002","quantityRequested":3,"quantityAvailable":0}

endpoints.name: Reservation validation fault demo
endpoints.description:
Description:
Demonstrate asking a shopper to correct an invalid reservation quantity before the checkout journey can continue.

Technical implementation:
Always returns a static 422 quantity error after global JSON syntax checks. This route does not inspect quantity or validate business fields; malformed JSON instead receives the runtime's 400 response.

response.body: {"type":"about:blank","title":"Unprocessable Entity","status":422,"detail":"The sample reservation quantity is invalid.","errors":{"quantity":["Quantity must be a positive whole number."]}}

endpoints.name: Warehouse outage fault demo
endpoints.description:
Description:
Exercise a temporary warehouse outage so the storefront can explain that stock information is unavailable instead of incorrectly reporting products as sold out.

Technical implementation:
Always returns 503 Service Unavailable with Retry-After: 30. Use it for outage and retry handling; waiting does not restore the fictional warehouse.

response.body: {"type":"about:blank","title":"Service Unavailable","status":503,"detail":"The sample warehouse service is unavailable. Retry later."}
